# Project Owner Intake

Use this template when the project starts from a goal, business need, or user
problem rather than an existing engineering plan.

This file is an intake artifact. It does not authorize implementation.

## Five Questions

1. What do you want to build or change?
2. Who will use it?
3. What problem does it solve right now?
4. What can a user do when it succeeds?
5. What are you most worried about?

## Clarified Inputs

| Topic | Answer |
|---|---|
| Product idea | `<one sentence>` |
| Target users | `<users>` |
| Current problem | `<problem>` |
| Desired user outcome | `<observable outcome>` |
| Biggest risks | `<risks>` |
| Non-goals | `<excluded scope>` |
| Existing assets | `<docs, code, design, data, or none>` |
| Constraints | `<timeline, budget, platform, compliance, ops, support>` |

## Project Owner Acceptance Signals

List evidence the project owner can understand without reading code.

| Signal | Evidence |
|---|---|
| `<signal>` | `<browser/API/report/demo/runtime evidence>` |

## Draft Outputs

These are planning outputs, not executable authorization.

| Output | Project-Selected Path | Status | Include When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Accepted compact blueprint / active SPEC | `<project-selected path>` | `<draft/ready>` | Always; this may authorize a direct zero-to-product route. |
| Capability map and any granularity audit | `<project-selected path or omit>` | `<conditional status>` | Uncertainty, dependencies, or risk make capability decomposition useful. |
| Executable roadmap | `<project-selected path or omit>` | `<conditional status>` | Sequencing or coordination needs a roadmap. |
| Phase or milestone authority rows | `<project-selected path or omit>` | `<conditional status>` | An explicitly selected profile or concrete risk requires them. |

## Readiness Before Implementation

Implementation may start only after:

- an independently acceptable product outcome is selected directly or through
  an optional capability map;
- the first product outcome has enough authority, scope, acceptance evidence,
  non-goals, and stop conditions to begin at its selected governance level;
- any entry gate or phase documents required by an explicitly selected
  Heavy/formal profile are ready.
